# AZ Data

> Data from A to Z. A real-time context layer for Snowflake: schema docs in Markdown, OKF, and a graph, published straight to your own Git repo, plus an MCP server that hands structured context to AI agents instead of giving them direct warehouse access.

## Product
- [Product overview & architecture](/product.html): DDL poller, renderer, MCP server
- [Real-time schema tracking](/product-tracking.html): Hash-diff of INFORMATION_SCHEMA every 1–5 minutes
- [Git-native publishing](/product-publishing.html): Markdown, OKF, and graph committed to GitHub or Bitbucket
- [Agents & MCP](/product-agents.html): Structured, annotated context for Claude, Cursor, and custom agents; zero warehouse queries
- [Solutions](/solutions.html): Agent grounding, schema change alerts, audit trail, onboarding docs, migration tracking, pipeline context
- [Pricing](/pricing.html): Per-user plans (Starter, Team, Enterprise) and FAQ

## Built with Claude
AZ Data uses Anthropic's Claude to enhance the platform: generating change explanations and business annotations, and validating every MCP release against Claude Code. Registered in Baku, Azerbaijan (44 Jafar Jabbarli Street, Baku 1065).
